shortDescription: Create, update, or delete GitLab issues

options.name: api_job_token
options.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

options.name: api_oauth_token
options.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: api_token
options.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

options.name: assignee_ids
options.description: A list of assignee usernames omitting V(@) character. Set to an empty array to unassign all assignees.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

options.name: description
options.description: A description of the issue. Gets overridden by a content of file specified at O(description_path), if found.

options.name: description_path
options.description: A path of file containing issue's description. Accepts MarkDown formatted files.

options.name: labels
options.description: A list of label names. Set to an empty array to remove all labels.

options.name: milestone_group_id
options.description: The path or numeric ID of the group hosting desired milestone.

options.name: milestone_search
options.description: The name of the milestone. Set to empty string to unassign milestone.

options.name: project
options.description: The path or name of the project.

options.name: state_filter
options.description: Filter specifying state of issues while searching.

options.name: title
options.description: A title for the issue. The title is used as a unique identifier to ensure idempotency.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint.
